set.tovw: Found: the $900 was dug up in Sept 1913 after the confessions

tw-mn-st-charles-express-silver-1913.st: Recovered: within a week both men confessed and one led the sheriff to a farm near St. Charles where the $900 was dug up.
src: The Post and Record (Rochester), 5 Sep 1913, p. 3

set.t: Trace the 1920 getaway route from the Jackson papers; wet ground along it was never searched. First reports said all loot was recovered; the later count showed $1,300 in coin missing. Access: unknown.
